GRUT.prose: The declared construction choices (system/bath, projection P, cutoff/separation, gauge prescription, response object) do not chain to a closed dynamical construction.

String_M.prose: Consistent construction does not select a unique physical vacuum (landscape/compactification ambiguity).

AdS_CFT.prose: The duality is established for AdS-type backgrounds; the bridge to our de Sitter-like cosmology is not established.

AsymptoticSafety.prose: The UV fixed point does not, at current truncation level, uniquely fix the full observed matter sector.

LQG.prose: The quantum-geometric representation does not yet chain to 4D dynamics and GR recovery (Hamiltonian constraint remains 'illusive').

GRUT.distribution: no DERIVED parameters on the record

cross_candidate_pattern.finding: The same unresolved-arrow pattern appears independently in unrelated frameworks: each chain stops at a DIFFERENT interface, not a shared one. GRUT stops at construction-choice closure; String/M at vacuum selection; AdS/CFT at de Sitter bridge; Asymptotic Safety at matter-sector uniqueness; LQG at 4D dynamics.
cross_candidate_pattern.not_interpreted_as: no claim that 'all frameworks are equal' or 'GRUT is vindicated'
cross_candidate_pattern.strongest_observation: No candidate on the audited record closes every arrow. The principal open arrows are interface-specific and do not coincide.

pre_registered_hypothesis_status: CONFIRMED under the audited record: no major candidate closes all nine arrows. This is a statement about the audited primary-source record, not a proof of impossibility.
